0-nfl.first_audit_reason: The prices, times, model figures and reported facts match the sources, but several passages refer to how the article was produced and must be rewritten. (1) Section 2, 'the supplied materials do not measure how any single input moved the forecast': 'supplied materials' points to internal inputs. Rephrase as a public-facing limitation, e.g. 'Fourth & Value has not published how much each team's projection contributes to the gap.' (2) Section 3, 'The excerpts say nothing about Arizona's defense, its offense, or either team's injury status for Sunday': this refers to source excerpts. Restate it as what had not been reported as of a stated Eastern time, e.g. 'As of 7:13 AM EDT Wednesday, neither team had released an injury report for Sunday, and NFL.com's coverage did not address Arizona's offense or defense.' (3) Section 4, 'though the materials do not show why': same problem. Rewrite without referencing materials, e.g. 'the estimate does not explain why.' (4) Optional: the 'key numbers' remark in Section 4 is unsourced and should be tied to the quoted lines or removed.
